caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a fluted ring cake pan, similar in shape to a Bundt pan, rendered in shades of gray and black. The pan is rounded with a raised, hollow cylindrical center, and its outer walls are evenly scalloped or fluted all around. The surface of the pan shows smooth shading to indicate volume and depth, with darker areas on the inside and outer edges to represent shadows. The background is plain, off-white or beige, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the image. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten note with two names: "C.D. Charon and HELEN HOSART."
title: Cake Mold
